name: 職業災害補償抵充 (§59 insurance offset)
authority: 勞基法 §59 但書: where labour or occupational-accident insurance, or other law, has already paid compensation for the same accident from premiums the employer funded, 雇主得予以抵充之 — the employer may offset it against its §59 compensation. Permissive: the run never computes it; an employer electing it enters the insurer benefit the worker received (e.g. 災保法 §42 傷病給付) for the §59(2) days paid through OCCUPATIONAL_INJURY_LEAVE. 施行細則 §10(7): 職業災害補償費 is not 工資, so the offset leaves every wage and insured base untouched and is taken from net pay. Owner rule 2026-09-28: law silent on the base; default none; lawful because the insured grades are declared, not read from the month, and withholding on the unreduced salary is an advance settled in the annual return.

name: 職業災害補償抵充 (§59 insurance offset)
authority: 勞基法 §59 但書: where labour or occupational-accident insurance, or other law, has already paid compensation for the same accident from premiums the employer funded, 雇主得予以抵充之 — the employer may offset it against its §59 compensation.
